messages:
ian: Quick heads-up — Garnet (prospect) asked for a multi-workload perf benchmark next Tue. They want: conv (200 sustained qps, spikes to 1k), embeddings (500 qps sustained), and a small rerank pipeline. Need a runbook we can share, a rough hosted vs Dedicated cost delta, and any security blockers. cc @devon @chetan @alyssa

devon: Got it. Can you confirm model sizes / variants they plan to use? That changes KV cache and batching behavior a lot. Also want target p95/p99 for conv.

ian: They said Llama-2-70B-like for conv (quantized variant ok), embedding model is small 2B, rerank is 7B. Targets: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms for conv (tail is important to them).

maria: FYI for a mixed workload run we should run three parallel scenarios and a composite traffic mix to mirror production: 60% conv, 30% embed, 10% rerank. Warm up with 15m steady-state to populate KV cache. Measure token-per-request distribution (they expect avg conv req = 120 tokens).

chetan: Draft runbook notes below — will refine. Paste into the doc and I can export as PDF for the AE.

loadtest-bot: ```
Runbook (sketch):
1) Prep: deploy sample app pointing to test endpoint (pin model variants)
2) Warmup: 15m at 10% target qps to warm prefixes/KV
3) Ramp: 10m linear to target sustained qps
4) Steady: 30m at sustained qps with periodic 1m bursts to peak
5) Measure: p50/p95/p99, tail latency histogram, token/sec, GPU util, queue depth
6) Failure scenarios: drop 1 node, force fallback to smaller model, network flakiness

Load tool: k6 for conv (http stream), vegeta for embed bursts. Example k6 snippet:

```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';

export default function() {
  http.post('https://test.redwood-inference/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: '...' }));
  sleep(0.1);
}
```
```

chetan: Add config notes: use 3 test clients in different AZs to avoid client-side convoying. Use token sampling to compute cost estimates. Log request/response sizes to estimate token counts.

devon: Operational notes: to hit p95/p99 we need aggressive async batching disabled for conv tail tests (we want per-request latency, not batched amortized). Also set KV cache TTL high so warmup is effective. If using Dedicated, reserve 4-8 GPU machines for the run depending on model qps.

maria: Quick back-of-envelope cost delta: hosted (pay-as-you-go) for the 1h stress run + 3h test window ~ $2.8k (compute heavy because 70B). Dedicated monthly commit to cover this sustained pattern: ~$18k/month for the pool (we'd amortize but they'd pay reservation). I'll send a more accurate estimate after we size GPUs.

ian: That helps, thanks. Can you give a 1-paragraph security checklist I can send to their infosec?

alyssa: Short checklist — sendable to customer: 
- Data path: TLS in transit, optional customer-managed KMS for model creds.
- Isolation: Dedicated pools for PII/regulated data; VPC peering or Private deployment options available.
- Auditing: request-level logs (redacted tokens) and retention options.
- Compliance: SOC2 + proactive attestations; we can start an NDA/DP agreement if needed.
- Pen tests: we can coordinate a scoping call.

ian: Perfect. Any enterprise blockers we should flag before scheduling?

chetan: One potential blocker: Garnet asked about HSM/KMS latency impact. For encrypt-in-flight we need to validate kex latency — usually negligible but call it out. Also if they insist on air-gapped on-prem we need 4–6 weeks lead time for Private deployment.

devon: Another note: if they want sub-300ms p95 on conv with a 70B model at 200 qps, we should test a quantized 8-bit variant or plan for model sharding across NVLink. Otherwise tail will be higher. Flag this as a technical tradeoff to the AE.

ian: Great. I'll prep the AE email with the runbook + checklist + cost ballpark. Can someone own the actual test run scheduling? Prefer Wed 09:00 PT next week.

chetan: I can kick it off. I'll provision test pool and share Terraform snippet + Grafana dashboard link.

loadtest-bot: ```
Terraform snippet (placeholder):
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "garnet-test" {
  size = "4-gpu-a10x"
  model_pin = "garnet-70B-q8"
  autoscale = false
}
```

ian: Awesome — thanks team :thumbsup: I’ll update the customer and loop back if they accept Wed.

maria: tagging follow-ups: @chetan please include exact GPU sku/expected NVLink config; @devon please add failure-injection steps to the run doc.

chetan: On it. I’ll upload the full runbook to the shared docs by EOD today.

alyssa: If infosec sends a questionnaire, ping me and I’ll fill the security sections.

ian: Closing thread for now — will reopen with confirmation from Garnet.
